reasoning: The large-and-small double bust clearly conveys an asymmetric two-person relationship: parent and child, guardian and dependent, or manager/mentor and report. It fits tasks about kids, childcare, parental controls, mentorship, and managing direct reports, though at small sizes it can blur into a generic two-person 'contacts' icon.
